items.title: Don Albert Interview, 1972-09-18
items.q: But I do read in Louisiana, Rita, about a lot of murders and things that go on here that are not associated with entertainment.

ctx.x: In Texas. When I first went to Dallas, there was a place where I played upstairs. They had a man on the door to search each customer to come up. They had a bucket there on the side to drop the knives and the pistols in until they come out. But I never recall seeing anything like that in New Orleans. And I'll play to some tremendous crowds here. At the old Santa Center Club when I played there. I remember 1500, man. In those days, 1500 is equal to 5,000, 6,000, 7,000, 8,000 a day. And I can't recall any arguments…
Well, yeah. That can happen anywhere. Right. On the street. Right.
